page: Microsoft Azure F80ads_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine built on AMD EPYC 9V45 processors operating at up to 4.5 GHz. The instance delivers 80 dedicated x86_64 physical cores configured with one thread per core, backed by 48 KB L1 data cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache per core cluster. It incorporates 320 GB of total RAM, corresponding to 4 GB per core, and integrates 9,448 GB of high-performance local NVMe SSD storage. The CPU instruction set includes AVX-512 extensions (F, VNNI, and BF16) along with accelerated hardware cryptography via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Benchmark results place the instance in the top 10% across multi-core compute and data-intensive metrics. It achieved a multi-core stress-ng score of 290,168.74, a PassMark CPU score of 128,668.08, and sustained memory bandwidth reaching 476.02 GB/sec for uncached read blocks. Local disk and in-memory execution throughput are demonstrated by 202.34 million Redis SET operations per second and 111.41 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. Natural language model inference tests show top-tier prompt evaluation at 5,722.82 tokens per second for small parameter models and robust execution for medium models.

The inclusion of 9,448 GB of direct-attached NVMe storage minimizes storage I/O latency without relying solely on network-attached disks, driving strong compute and storage density per node. A single thread per physical core architecture avoids hyperthreading contention, ensuring predictable latency profiles. However, with no discrete GPU accelerators and a 1:4 core-to-memory ratio, workloads requiring massive per-thread memory pools or hardware-accelerated deep learning training will face hardware constraints.

Microsoft Azure F80ads_v7 is suited for compute-intensive and I/O-heavy enterprise workloads, including large-scale database clusters, multi-threaded scientific simulations, distributed CI/CD build farms, high-throughput caching layers, and high-concurrency web serving infrastructure.
description: Microsoft Azure F80ads_v7 is a compute-optimized instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processors running at up to 4.5 GHz across 80 physical x86_64 cores. Built without hyperthreading, each core operates on a single execution thread, paired with 320 GB of system memory and 9,448 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage. Hardware capabilities feature AVX-512 vector extensions alongside AES and SHA instruction sets. In synthetic and real-world benchmarks, the instance demonstrates top-tier multi-threaded compute, memory bandwidth, and database caching performance, reaching over 202 million Redis operations per second. The large bundled NVMe storage tier provides high-throughput scratch space and temporary database persistence, reducing external network storage dependencies. Microsoft Azure F80ads_v7 is best fitted for high-concurrency batch processing, continuous integration build pipelines, relational and in-memory databases, and high-throughput static or dynamic web services.
